title.narrative: Support to Regional Economic Integration

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Action is to strengthen regional cooperation and further develop a competitive regional economic area. The specific objective of the Action is to support the implementation of AP5 and AP6 in the frame of the CEFTA Agreements Trade Pillar and the Multi-Annual Action Plan for a Regional Economic Area in the Western Balkans (MAP REA).
